title: 第23章 陶器第24章 水车
slug: 从哥布林开始骑马砍杀
content_zh:
得到了大量工具，李秦武欣喜万分，这时候他根本不在乎艰难屯里苟延残喘的人类，他现在只有一个想法，建设，建设，还是踏马的建设！
除了大哥布林依旧监视艰难屯里的人类，其他哥布林全部开始工作！
李秦武让他们去砍树，挖掘树根，砍下来的树当场处理成建筑材料打到地下制成房梁，空地也都挖掘开来，种植带来的土豆。
等所有哥布林都能分到自己的屋舍，李秦武又让人在地下挖了个坑，把大量木材扔进去，点燃后用泥巴把木材全部闷住，第二天挖开，里面就全是黑漆漆的木炭了。
有了煤炭，李秦武立马搭建烧窑，他沿着河边走，找到了粘土，用粘土捏了陶器。
陶器制作其实没多困难，用粘土捏出想要的陶器形状，把火炉烧旺，将其放入里面烧制就能得到陶器。
如果第一次烧制失败，陶器上有裂缝也不要紧，将第1次烧制的陶器打碎磨成粉，混入第2次烧制的粘土，能大幅度增加成功率。
当天李秦武就成功烧制了一批陶器，锅碗瓢盆都有，他把烧制的煮锅拍成一排，把所有哥布林都集中起来。
李秦武捧着一个陶碗，用新闻频道腔激动的朝哥布林们喊道：“兄弟们！从现在开始，我们从茹毛饮血的野兽大踏步走进熟食时代！这是部落的一小步，却是哥布林种群的一大步。
尽管你们还不知道这意味着什么，但不要紧，时间会证明一切，今天不用工作，放开肚皮能吃多少东西就吃多少东西吧！”
李秦武一声令下，哥布林们陷入欢乐的海洋，他们按照李秦武的要求，烧起篝火，树起陶锅，往里面倒入水，放入鲜肉，蔬菜烹煮。
从此以后，李秦武手里的哥布林永远脱离了茹毛饮血，再吃生食生水会被处以鞭刑。
城墙上的人们默默看着欢呼的哥布林，不知道哥布林们又发什么神经。
这几天哥布林都没进攻城堡，一直就是砍树挖坑搞建设，森林的边缘退的越来越远，哥布林小屋越来越多，呈现出一个小村落之势，哥布林的建设速度之快让他们咋舌。
哥布林花了一个月不到就建成了一个小村庄，换做他们人类，得耗费大量资金粮食，领主和他的书记管家要日夜伏案调剂人口，才能做到同等体量的工程。
哈娜小姐，蒙德管家，雷奥骑士三人站在城墙上，目光阴郁的盯着哥布林村庄，这些家伙今早就一直喧闹不停，搞得他们神经紧张，还以为哥布林又要发起进攻。
结果对方居然在开趴体，煮肉汤，关键是，那肉香味弥漫开来，让好几天没吃饱喝足的几人都感觉一阵难受，比亚迪哥布林做饭这么香的吗？
这几天他们发现一个要命的问题，比起能坚持3个月的食物，他们已经没水了。
城堡建设之初，他们只想着抵御魔兽攻击，根本没考虑过会被敌人围城，所以也没考虑过水源。
现在一下被哥布林围了一个多月，他们城内的饮水已经消耗一空，每天的饮水全都靠哈娜小姐用魔法凝聚水元素。

哈娜小姐现在已经变成一个人形饮水机，每天不是运转魔法制造水元素就是等待魔力恢复继续制造水元素，她整个人都憔悴了，黑眼圈都干出来了。
疲惫的哈娜小姐小鼻子一嗅，她能闻出对面煮的肉汤里放了不少东西，有兔子肉，有鹿肉，有胡萝卜，有洋葱，浓浓的一锅肉汤，香的它不停的流口水。
“该死！这群混蛋一大早上就开始闹腾，到底图些什么啊，过光神节吗？”
蒙德管家闻着空气中蔬菜的香味，也是咽了口唾沫。
“我们的粮食越来越少，没有新鲜蔬菜的摄入，老夫我已经便秘很久了……”
雷蒙骑士也哀叹道：“没有新鲜的肉，士兵会变得越来越虚弱，哥布林如果发起进攻，士兵们连武器都拿不起来，而且少爷他自从被救回来，再也没出过门，整个人都，唉……”
三人都叹了口气，雷蒙少爷被救回来后，整个人都神经质了，躲在自己小屋里不敢出来。
城堡的最高首领都这副样子，导致城堡里众人士气十分低落。
众人正emo呢，突然看到一个大哥布林走了过来，这一幕让众人的心又提了起来。
哥布矛径直走到城墙下，大声朝上面的人类问：“喂，会说哥布林话的人类雌性在不在？我们老大有事问你们！”
哈娜小姐愣了一下，把这话翻译给另外两人。
三人对视一眼，哈娜小姐问：“你们的首领想问什么？”
“老大说今天是值得纪念的日子，哥布林从一个时代跨入了另一个时代，啥意思俺也不懂，总之告诉我今天是几号？这个日期以后要上哥布林教科书。”
三人一阵面面相觑，什么跟什么啊这。
哈娜小姐觉得这问题也不涉及性命，便回答道：“今天是众神纪4352年4月20日。”
哥布矛站在原地花了几分钟记这串数字，然后他拿起一个袋子朝城墙上的人摇了摇。
“我们老大说要和你们做个交易，一袋蔬菜换一套书写工具！”
哈？哥布林要书写工具，这世界真的疯了吗？
三人看着那袋食物疯狂咽唾沫，正如蒙德管家说的，他们已经很久没吃蔬菜了，没有膳食纤维光吃黑面包，人很快就会拉不出屎，就连美丽的哈娜小姐都因此变的色素沉着了。
三人正犹豫不决，哥布矛有些烦了。

“换不换给个痛快话！老大说了，你们这些人类就是磨叽，他以哥布林之王，万族的奴役者，世界的鞭挞者，神明的毁灭者，魔法森林的唯一正统主人，亚瑟.路易.罗曼诺夫?.秦始皇的伟大名义起示，没在蔬菜里下毒，搞快点，我等着回去吃饭呢！”
最终老管家蒙德把他的一套书写工具扔下城墙，换了这些蔬菜。
后来他们经过测试，发现这些蔬菜真的没有下毒，于是几个高层把这些蔬菜分了，轻微缓解便秘，至于那些普通老农，管不了这么多力，堵着吧。
哥布矛跑回营地，把书写工具拿给李秦武就跑去炫饭了。
李秦武摊开羊皮纸，用羽毛笔蘸着墨水开始画图，他要规划未来哥布林帝国的首都！
content_en:
Li Qinwu was overjoyed to get a lot of tools. At this time, he didn't care about the surviving humans in the difficult villages. He only had one idea now, construction, construction, construction on horseback!
Except for the eldest goblin who still monitors the humans in Hard Village, the other goblins all started to work!
Li Qinwu asked them to cut down trees and dig out tree roots. The cut trees were processed into building materials on the spot and driven into the ground to make beams. The open space was also dug up and the potatoes brought there were planted.
After all the goblins were assigned their own houses, Li Qinwu had someone dig a hole in the ground, throw a large amount of wood into it, light it, and suffocate the wood with mud. When he dug it out the next day, it was full of black charcoal.
With coal, Li Qinwu immediately built a kiln. He walked along the river, found clay, and used the clay to make pottery.
Making pottery is actually not that difficult. Use clay to shape the pottery you want, heat the stove, put it in and fire it, and you will get pottery.
If the first firing fails and there are cracks in the pottery, it doesn't matter. Crush the first fired pottery into powder and mix it with the second fired clay to greatly increase the success rate.
Li Qinwu successfully fired a batch of pottery that day, including pots and pans. He arranged the fired pots in a row and gathered all the goblins.
Li Qinwu held a pottery bowl and shouted excitedly to the Goblins in a news channel voice: "Brothers! From now on, we will make great strides from beasts that drink blood into the age of cooked food! This is a small step for the tribe, but a giant leap for the Goblin population.
Although you don’t know what this means yet, it doesn’t matter, time will tell everything. You don’t have to work today, just eat as much as you can! "
Li Qinwu gave an order, and the goblins fell into a sea of joy. According to Li Qinwu's request, they lit a bonfire, set up a clay pot, poured water into it, put in fresh meat, and cooked vegetables.
From then on, the goblins in Li Qinwu's hands were forever freed from eating raw food and drinking blood. If they ate raw food or water again, they would be whipped.
The people on the city wall silently looked at the cheering goblins, wondering what the goblins were up to.
In the past few days, the goblins have not attacked the castle. They have been cutting down trees and digging pits for construction. The edge of the forest is receding further and further, and there are more and more goblin huts, showing the trend of a small village. The speed of the goblin construction makes them stunned.
It took the goblins less than a month to build a small village. For humans, it would have cost a lot of money and food. The lord and his secretary and steward had to work day and night to adjust the population in order to complete a project of the same size.
Miss Hana, Butler Mond, and Knight Leo stood on the city wall, staring at the Goblin village with gloomy eyes. These guys had been making a lot of noise this morning, which made them nervous. They thought the Goblins were going to attack again.
It turned out that the other party was actually having a party and making broth. The key was that the aroma of the meat filled the air, making several people who had not eaten and drank for several days feel uncomfortable. Is BYD Goblin's cooking so fragrant?
In the past few days, they have discovered a fatal problem. Compared with the food that can last for 3 months, they have run out of water.
At the beginning of the construction of the castle, they only thought about resisting attacks from monsters. They did not consider that the city would be besieged by enemies, so they did not consider water sources.
They have been surrounded by goblins for more than a month now, and the drinking water in their city has been exhausted. All their daily drinking water relies on Miss Hana using magic to condense water elements.
Miss Hana has now turned into a human-shaped water dispenser. Every day she is either running magic to create water elements or waiting for the magic power to recover to continue creating water elements. She is haggard and has dark circles under her eyes.
The tired Miss Hana sniffed with her little nose, and she could smell that there were a lot of things in the broth cooked on the opposite side, including rabbit meat, venison, carrots, onions, and thick soup.The thick pot of broth is so fragrant that it keeps drooling.
"Damn it! These bastards started making noise early in the morning. What are they planning? Are they celebrating the Festival of Light?"
Butler Mond swallowed his saliva as he smelled the aroma of vegetables in the air.
"Our food supply is getting less and less. Without the intake of fresh vegetables, I have been constipated for a long time..."
Knight Raymond also lamented: "Without fresh meat, the soldiers will become weaker and weaker. If the goblins attack, the soldiers will not be able to pick up their weapons. Moreover, the young master has never left the house since he was rescued. His whole body is, alas..."
The three of them sighed. After Master Raymond was rescued, he became very nervous and hid in his hut and did not dare to come out.
The top leader of the castle looked like this, which caused the morale of everyone in the castle to be very low.
Everyone was emo when they suddenly saw a big brother Blin walking over. This scene made everyone's hearts rise again.
Goblin Spear walked straight to the city wall and loudly asked the humans above: "Hey, are there any human females who can speak Goblin? Our boss has something to ask you!"
Miss Hana was stunned for a moment and translated this to the other two people.
The three of them looked at each other and Miss Hana asked: "What does your leader want to ask?"
"The boss said that today is a memorable day. Goblins have crossed from one era to another. I don't understand what it means. Anyway, tell me what day it is today? This date will be included in the Goblin textbook in the future."
The three of them looked at each other in confusion for a while, wondering what was going on.
Miss Hana felt that this question did not involve life, so she replied: "Today is April 20, Year 4352 of the Gods."
Gob Mao stood there for a few minutes and memorized the numbers. Then he picked up a bag and shook it at the people on the wall.
"Our boss said he would make a deal with you, a bag of vegetables in exchange for a set of writing tools!"
Huh? Goblins want writing tools. Is the world really crazy?
The three of them looked at the bag of food and swallowed furiously. Just as Mond's housekeeper said, they had not eaten vegetables for a long time. Without dietary fiber and only eating black bread, people would soon be unable to poop. Even the beautiful Miss Hana became hyperpigmented.
The three of them were hesitating, and Gobu Mao was a little annoyed.
"Why don't you give me a sweet word? The boss said that you humans are Moji. In the name of the King of Goblins, the enslaver of all races, the whipper of the world, the destroyer of gods, the only orthodox master of the magic forest, Arthur Louis Romanov?. Qin Shihuang, he didn't poison the vegetables. Hurry up, I'm waiting to go back for dinner!"
Finally, the old butler Mond threw his set of writing tools off the city wall and replaced them with these vegetables.
Later, after testing, they found that these vegetables were really not poisonous, so several senior officials divided these vegetables to slightly relieve constipation. As for ordinary farmers, they couldn't control so much and just blocked it.
Gobu Mao ran back to the camp, gave Li Qinwu his writing tools, and went to show off his rice.
Li Qinwu spread out the parchment, dipped his quill pen in ink and started drawing. He wanted to plan the future capital of the Goblin Empire!
